audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Yone levels 3 and 4-5, but the whys under those rows say 'Level 3 is even' and 'keep the lane balanced'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Yone, Yone, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone, Yone and the existing whys for rows 2 and 3 already describe an even lane. The chart labels contradicted the text on the same rows.
audit.corrected: Set rows 2 and 3 to Skill in both layers so the chart matches its own explanations and the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the page tells you to commit 'on Permafrost's cooldown'.
audit.why: Permafrost is on 1.5 seconds. There is no cooldown window to play around — the gate is Frost stacks, since the ability only stuns a target at maximum stacks. The cooldown that actually matters is Arctic Assault at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, her single gap-close, and Glacial Prison at 120/105/90s.
audit.corrected: Count Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1) as the punishable cooldown and Frost stacks as the stun gate; stop telling the player to wait out a 1.5-second ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stun chain is described backwards ('Stack Permafrost with Q/W/E'), Frost Armor is conflated with Frost stacks, and the passive's shatter damage is never mentioned.
audit.why: Winter's Wrath applies Frost stacks; Permafrost consumes maximum stacks to stun. Fury of the North is a separate out-of-combat Armor/MR buff that also grants slow immunity — so Winter's Wrath's slow does nothing to a fresh Sejuani. And 'Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage' means being stunned is not a minor inconvenience, it is the burst the page claims she does not have. Per the mirror, Soul Unbound also does not escape this: the spirit is forced back to the body Yone left behind, so she can stand on the body and hold Permafrost for the snap-back.
audit.corrected: Frost comes from Winter's Wrath; Permafrost stuns only at max stacks and her passive then shatters you for heavy magic damage. Do not use Soul Unbound with stacks on you — the body tells her exactly where you land.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns builds the whole lane plan around Permafrost's cooldown.
audit.why: Same 1.5-second problem as point 3 — the advice is unusable as written.
audit.corrected: Rebuild it around Arctic Assault's 18-second rank-1 cooldown and Frost-stack tracking.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Permafrost's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade around Arctic Assault, 18 seconds at rank 1 — her one gap-close. Permafrost is on 1.5s, so count Frost stacks instead.

edits.after: - Sejuani Arctic Assault: matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, her only gap-close and the cooldown worth counting. Permafrost sits on 1.5s: track your Frost stacks, not its cooldown. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: packet suspectName 'Hold Glacial Prison' in wants.foe[2] is a FALSE POSITIVE — Glacial Prison is the correct Riot name for Sejuani's R. Two real defects the scanner did not catch: (1) the page treats Permafrost as a cooldown to play around when it is a 1.5-second ability gated on Frost stacks, and (2) it says Sejuani has no burst while omitting Fury of the North's shatter, which deals massive magic damage to a stunned target. The 'she can't kill you solo' framing in mid/late rests on that omission — left the prose alone rather than rewrite it on an unverified damage estimate, but flagging it. focus.text ('Sejuani Permafrost') is under 25 characters so the applier skips it; if it can be changed by hand it should read as Frost stacks, not Permafrost.
